name: architect-handbook
description: Unofficial. The architecture judgement behind the Claude Certified Architect blueprints as a Claude Code plugin: 68 decision rules, 38 at Professional level (agents, tools and credentials, MCP, RAG, evals, human review, guardrails, compliance data flows, model tier, caching, SLAs, team setup) and 30 at Foundations level (agent loops, subagent briefs, enforcement in hooks, tool descriptions and errors, MCP and Claude Code configuration, structured output, batch, escalation, provenance), each with the deciding cue, the right call and the tempting wrong call. A rules skill that answers design questions, a review skill that gates plans and workflows, a hook that fires the rules while you build, and a 216-term vocabulary for non-developers.
